description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the CustomFieldAPI, testing various CRUD operations, validations, and internal method calls related to CustomField management in the HRM system.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the CustomFieldAPI, covering its CRUD operations and validation rules.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldService
methods.description: Tests that the CustomFieldAPI correctly returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single custom field by ID and validating the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for fetching a single custom field.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field and verifies the returned normalized data.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeExtraData
methods.description: Tests update operation when the extraData of a custom field is changed, including deletion of related data.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeType
methods.description: Tests update operation when changing the type of a custom field that is in use, expecting a bad request.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates rules for updating a custom field.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a custom field, expecting not found exception if conditions are not met.

methods.name: testDeleteNoInUse
methods.description: Tests deletion when the custom field is not in use.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates rules for deleting custom fields.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new custom field and verifies the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates rules for creating a custom field.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests fetching all custom fields with search and count.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates rules for fetching all custom fields.
